subject: Discovery Recap + MAP (draft) — Valen Systems
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Michael Tran <michael.tran@valensys.com>, Priya Ramesh <priya.r@valensys.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery Recap + MAP (draft) — Valen Systems

Hi Michael and Priya,

Thanks again for the call today — appreciated the candidness on latency and operational constraints. Below is a short recap and the attached Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft that captures milestones, owners, and a proposed decision timeline. Please review and flag any inaccuracies.

Key pain points we heard
- Production latency sensitivity: tail p99 target <= 220ms for peak inference on customer-facing features.
- Cost predictability: finance needs a clear committed spend band vs variable usage.
- Data governance: logs/audit retention (90 days) and optional customer-side KV encryption are must-haves.

Business goals driving this initiative
- Launch in Q3 with 2M monthly active inference requests for the main recommender flow.
- Reduce per-call inference cost by ~35% vs current self-hosted baseline via batching/caching.
- Keep model outputs explainable for auditors (traceable prompts/evals).

Proposed MAP highlights (attached: Valen_MAP_draft_20270302.pdf)
- Pilot kickoff (integration + 2-week test): target Mar 28 — Valen: Ezra Kim (Integration Lead); Redwood: Avery Johnson (Eng).
- Performance validation (latency & tail SLAs): target Apr 15 — run with production-like load.
- Procurement & legal: target May 10 — procurement to complete SOW and T&Cs.
- Go/no-go decision: May 24 with exec sponsors from both sides.

Open asks from Redwood
1) Can you confirm the exec sponsor for the May decision (we heard it might be Priya or CTO)?
2) Would Valen be open to a 6–9 month committed capacity contract for the pilot-to-production runway (we noted finance preference for committed pricing)?
3) Please share the standard SOC2/RFI contact (we can send a tailored packet).

Attachments: Valen_MAP_draft_20270302.pdf, Redwood-Initial-Estimate.xlsx (initial capacity and pricing ranges).

Next steps (from Redwood)
- We’ll update the MAP with any corrections and send a versioned PDF by EOD tomorrow.
- Avery will share a short integration checklist for the API + KV caching by Thu.

If this all looks right, we’ll propose a short exec sync (30 minutes) to lock the decision owner and PO timeline — are you available next week?

Thanks,

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Michael Tran <michael.tran@valensys.com>

Cc: Ezra Kim <ezra.kim@valensys.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery Recap + MAP (draft) — Valen Systems

Vanessa — thanks for the crisp recap and the MAP draft. A few quick notes from our side after syncing with product and finance: 

- Exec sponsor: confirmed — Priya Ramesh (Head of Product Ops) will be the decision owner for the May 24 go/no-go.
- Procurement: we have a standard procurement window; procurement expects a redlined SOW and a security pack (SOC2 + data flow diagram). Can you send the SOC2 summary and an example DPA?
- Timeline: Apr 15 performance validation works, but our engineering calendar has a code freeze Apr 6–9. Can we shift the heavy load run to Apr 18–20 instead?

Pricing: finance asked for a worked example showing committed vs variable cost at 2M MAU — the Excel was useful but can you provide one scenario with committed 6-month pricing?

On integration owners: Ezra will be the integration lead and will coordinate infra access. He’ll do a short technical discovery on Wed afternoon (Mar 3) if that works for Avery.

Also looping in our security reviewer (I’ll send their contact after I confirm availability).

—Michael
Michael Tran
VP Product Operations | Valen Systems
michael.tran@valensys.com | +1 (650) 555-0210

Thanks Michael — really helpful. Priya — great to meet you over email (and thanks for taking the sponsorship). A few quick confirmations and internal asks so we stay aligned: 

Confirmations for the MAP
- Decision owner: Priya Ramesh (confirmed).
- Integration lead: Ezra Kim (Valen) / Avery Johnson (Redwood).
- Shifted performance validation window: Apr 18–20 (we’ll update MAP).

Internal notes / asks (Avery/LAUREN) — copying you for clarity:
- Avery: please coordinate a Wed Mar 3 technical discovery with Ezra. Key checklist items: API key rotation, KV retention rules, expected sequence lengths, and synthetic load plan for Apr 18–20.
- Avery: produce the committed-pricing scenario (6 months) by EOD Mar 4 — base it on the ranges in Redwood-Initial-Estimate.xlsx and include clear unit math for finance.
- Lauren: Valen asked about an example DPA and SOC2 summary. Can we share the SOC2 summary and the standard DPA template? If we need a redline exception on retention, flag here.

I’ll push updated MAP + timeline by COB tomorrow (Mar 3). 

Vanessa
